goal_slice: Server Control Plane Completion / Operator Console Hardening
summary: Promoted Settings config save from honest mustbuild placeholder to a narrow live PATCH /api/config seam for allowlisted config-backed fields, preserving env-controlled read-only semantics and restart-required receipts.
implemented: Added config.SaveSettings to merge validated operator settings into settings.json.
Added JSON loading and reload change detection for ENGRAM_INJECT_UNIFIED.

Added admin-only PATCH /api/config with strict bounded single-document JSON decoding, unsupported-field rejection, env-controlled conflict responses, allowlisted settings persistence, hot apply for hot fields, and restart_required_fields receipt for restart-only fields.
Updated GET /api/flags apply metadata from mustbuild to live allowlisted PATCH /api/config evidence.
Updated Settings modal to edit memory.inject_unified and features.enforce_source_project through the live mutation seam while telemetry remains disabled/read-only.
Updated ru/en/zh i18n for config save action, receipt, rollback error, and honest settings descriptions.
Updated mock operator API, seam test, browser smoke, and UI surface ledger for the new live seam.
Addressed PR review feedback by serializing settings.json read-modify-write with a package mutex and writing through a same-directory temp file before rename.
Kept restart-required config fields effective-value honest: persisted changes wait for process restart instead of silently changing live behavior.
remaining_gaps: Telemetry and most runtime settings remain read-only or mustbuild until backed by real server seams.
PATCH /api/config currently covers only features.enforce_source_project and memory.inject_unified.
Audit log for config changes is still not implemented.
Broader env-to-settings import/migration remains future server-control-plane work.

honesty_notes: Env-controlled settings return HTTP 409 instead of pretending the UI changed the effective value.
Unsupported known fields, including features.telemetry_enabled, return HTTP 400 and remain non-operable in the UI.
memory.inject_unified returns restart_required_fields because the operator needs an explicit restart/apply signal.
Restart-required fields are persisted for the next process start but the current process snapshot keeps the old effective value until restart.
